modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.
injury.detail: Avdija missed his first game of the 2026-27 campaign Tuesday. If he stays on the shelf for a second consecutive contest, Jayson Kent is in line to remain in the starting lineup

injury.shortComment: Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.
injury.detail: Camara is in danger of missing his first game of the season due to general soreness. If he's forced to the sidelines, his minutes will be divvied up amongst Siddy Cissoko and Jrue Holiday.

injury.shortComment: Rollins (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game at Miami.
injury.detail: Rollins wasn't included on the initial injury report, though he's since been ruled out for a second straight game due to an illness. His next chance to play will come Thursday versus Portland. With the 24-year-old combo guard sidelined, Kasparas Jakucionis and Gary Trent will likely continue seeing increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks, Charlie Walton of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
injury.detail: After missing Tuesday's game against Portland, Kuminga now has a chance to return Thursday from a bruised shoulder. His status will affect Terrence Shannon's streaming appeal most prominently in fantasy leagues.

injury.shortComment: Stewart (illness) won't play Wednesday against the Cavs.
injury.detail: This will be Stewart's second straight game on the sidelines, which should lead to more minutes for Taylor Hendricks and Quinten Post. Stewart's next chance to play will come Thursday against the Warriors.

injury.shortComment: Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Horford will miss the first half of a back-to-back set Wednesday due to a back injury, but will be available Thursday. Charles Bassey could see an expanded role in Horford's absence, while Horford could see a larger role than usual Thursday with Draymond Green set to rest.

injury.shortComment: Green (elbow) is available for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
injury.detail: Green was deemed questionable ahead of Wednesday's bout due to a right elbow injury, but he will be able to play through it. Over his last five appearances, Green holds averages of 3.4 points, 6.8 assists, 5.0 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 24.6 minutes per contest.

injury.shortComment: Pullin (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: Pullin is battling a quad injury. However, he has averaged only 3.3 minutes in his three regular-season appearances during the 2026-27 campaign, so his status for Thursday's meeting with New York won't affect the rotation.
